definitions.ask: Should the group row stay as its own slimmed second row under the step row?
definitions.why: The neighbouring group's name stays visible, which is the row's whole point

choices.label: Second row shows only icon + group name per arm and a tick track in the centre
No second row; group arms become icon-only buttons at the step row's outer edges

definitions.ask: Which mark should replace the «/» on group arms?
definitions.why: Widely read as "jump a whole section"; never mistaken for quotes or step arrows

choices.label: Lucide skip-back / skip-forward icons, the media previous/next-chapter mark
Small muted key chips reading [N and ]N, the keys each arm runs
The step row's ‹ / ›, with the group name drawn as a property-style pill

definitions.ask: Should the status-bar links walker footer get the same mark and declutter?
definitions.why: The screenshot shows the same «/» and duplication there; one change keeps both consistent
